Name: Moose's Challenge
Author: SrMoose
Description:
🫎 Moose's Challenge
Turn your farm into a golden cage. Block all exits and you won't be able to leave until you reach the amount of gold you choose.
✦ Features
🚧 Blocks the exits of all 8 farm types in Stardew Valley. You can choose which ones to activate through Generic Mod Config Menu.
💰 Configurable gold goal: from 1,000,000 to 100,000,000. You can also set a custom amount by editing "content.json" and "config.json".
🎁 Reward for completing the challenge: you'll receive a letter with 3 rewards:

⭐ Stardrop
🗿 Statue of Endless Fortune
💎 Prismatic Shard

Important: You must have three empty slots when receiving the letter, otherwise you will only receive two rewards.

🔓 Challenge completed: once you reach the goal, the exits will be unlocked on the day you receive the letter. (PC only)
On ANDROID, the exits will be unlocked the following day after receiving the letter.
🌎 Automatic language: the letter will appear in English or Spanish depending on your game language.
👥 Multiplayer: compatible with Shared Money. Gold earned by any player counts toward the shared goal, and everyone receives the letter and rewards.
🏠 Separate Money: if the multiplayer game uses Separate Money, only the Host's earned gold will count toward the goal, although all players will receive the rewards when the challenge is completed.
📦 Requirements
SMAPI — required.
Content Patcher — required.
[center]Generic Mod Config Menu — optional, recommended for configuring the challenge in-game.[/center]
